Q6111.reason: A general littering ban is a content-neutral O'Brien regulation of conduct that serves park cleanliness and only incidentally burdens symbolic speech.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove; the plaintiff's removal was unauthorized, so the defendant's timely remand motion returns the whole case.

Q5651.reason: Advertising the car as a 1964 creates an express warranty of description that an as-is clause cannot disclaim under UCC 2-316.
